title: Initialize @nx-oxc/nx
description: Install oxlint/oxfmt, scaffold configs, and register inference plugins in nx.json.

oxlint.description: Install oxlint and register `@nx-oxc/nx/oxlint` for inferred lint targets.

oxfmt.description: Install oxfmt and register `@nx-oxc/nx/oxfmt` for inferred format targets.

createOxlintConfig.description: Create a workspace-level `.oxlintrc.json` when one does not already exist.

createOxfmtConfig.description: Create a workspace-level `.oxfmtrc.json` when one does not already exist.

lintTargetName.description: Name of the inferred oxlint target.

formatTargetName.description: Name of the inferred oxfmt format target.

formatCheckTargetName.description: Name of the inferred oxfmt format-check target.

removeEslintPlugin.description: Remove `@nx/eslint/plugin` from nx.json (does not uninstall ESLint packages).
